resources.string: Your changes upload right away. iOS decides when background refresh runs, so the interval is the shortest gap between syncs. iPhone calendars sync through their own accounts.

If you add a CalDAV/Nextcloud account, an ICS URL, or iPhone calendars, the app uses the configured server, URL, or the iPhone's calendar data so syncing can work. KGS Calendar has no ads, analytics SDKs, tracking SDKs, or developer-operated backend.

KGS Calendar stores events, tasks, reminders, settings, source names, server URLs, usernames, and cached calendar data on this device. CalDAV passwords and app passwords are stored in the iOS Keychain for this device only, so they are not moved to another device by a backup.

Removing a calendar source deletes its local credentials and cached data but leaves server calendars unchanged. The separate “Delete server calendar” action permanently deletes that calendar from its CalDAV server. Uninstalling the app deletes local app data from this device, but iOS can keep saved passwords in the Keychain. To delete a password too, remove the calendar source before you uninstall.
KGS Calendar keeps running in the notification area, so your reminders still appear. Quit it from the icon there.
Location search is optional. Searches are sent to OpenStreetMap Nominatim only when you press Enter.

KGS Calendar stores events, tasks, reminders, settings, source names, server URLs, usernames, and cached calendar data on this PC. CalDAV passwords and app passwords are encrypted with Windows data protection for your Windows user.

If you add a CalDAV/Nextcloud account or an ICS URL, the app uses the configured server or URL so syncing can work. KGS Calendar has no ads, analytics SDKs, tracking SDKs, or developer-operated backend.

Location search is optional. When you press Search, the query is sent to OpenStreetMap Nominatim. The Windows app doesn\'t use your location. Map previews are loaded from OpenStreetMap only after you choose to show a preview, unless automatic previews are turned on under General.

Removing a calendar source deletes its local credentials and cached data but leaves server calendars unchanged. The separate “Delete server calendar” action permanently deletes that calendar from its CalDAV server. Uninstalling the app does not delete your data. To delete it, remove the folder %LOCALAPPDATA%\\KGS501\\KGS Calendar yourself.
KGS Calendar opens when you sign in to Windows. You can also change this in Windows Settings under Apps > Startup.
Closing the window keeps KGS Calendar in the notification area, so reminders still appear and it opens again at once. Turned off, closing the window quits the app.
Keep the tasks open beside the calendar
Keys for creating, searching and the views
Click an action, then press its keys. Backspace removes a shortcut, Escape keeps the old one. The arrow keys always move through the calendar.
Press and hold an event or task in the day or multi-day view, then drag it to another time or day, or up into the all-day row.
Tap a task\'s circle to complete it. Press and hold the circle to mark it as in progress, cancelled or open instead.
Tap a date at the top of the multi-day view to show only that day. Tap it again to see all days.
Drag the handle at the top of a sheet up or down to show more or less of it, or sideways to see more of the calendar. Sheets open where you last put them.
Drag the small pill between two columns to give either side more room. The sizes are kept for next time.
Most actions have a key: T jumps to today, D, W, M, Y and A switch the view and Ctrl+N creates an event. You can change them under Keyboard shortcuts.
